title: Concept: SQL built by concatenation (csharp) — review required
description: In csharp, ExecuteReaders*((?:[^()]|([^()]*))*+|$"(?:SELECT|INSERT|UPDA mixes code and data in one SQL string. Concatenation is the classic injection primitive: quotes and keywords in the input rewrite the statement. The remedy is bound parameters via SqlParameter bindings.
applicability: csharp codebases issuing SQL through the flagged call; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Full database compromise (read, write, execute) when untrusted input reaches the query; HIGH severity.
